caption:
washing your hands 15 times a day?

In one trial, 132 healthy adults washed their hands 15 times a day for two weeks. The groups that put on moisturizer after each wash kept their hands in the same condition.

The soap-only group got measurably worse by day 14.

Keep a small tube by the sink and use it after every wash.

Save this if your hands feel tight after washing.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Source:
Williams et al., Br J Dermatol 2010. doi:10.1111/j.1365-2133.2010.09643.x
